items.title: Los Angeles
items.detail: Five days on the west coast before the transpacific leg. Lodging not booked.

items.title: Los Angeles to Seoul
items.detail: KE 012 departs 23:50. Overnight, arriving Incheon on the morning of the 29th.

items.title: Seoul to Xi'an
items.detail: KE 141, 09:10 to 11:30. Check in at The Westin Xi'an from 15:00.

items.title: Xi'an
items.detail: Full day. Terracotta Warriors, and the Ming city wall - rentable bikes on the ramparts. Sandra also flagged Xiaojing Pavilion.

items.title: Xi'an to Lhasa by rail
items.detail: Z165 or Z265, soft sleeper, boarding in Xi'an. Not ticketed yet. National Day holiday begins - expect crowds.

items.title: Arrive Lhasa - 3,656 m
items.detail: Met by Asia Odyssey. Acclimatisation day: drink water, eat light, walk slowly, no exertion. Altitude sickness usually shows up 6-12 hours after arrival.

items.title: Tibet tour
items.detail: Seven days with Kamana, Jeff, Anissa and Alka. James was confirming whether five travellers still qualifies for the private-tour upgrade. Day-by-day plan still to come.

items.title: Lhasa to Shanghai
items.detail: MU 2336, 15:30 to 21:50, changing planes at Xi'an. Lands at Hongqiao. Kamana and possibly Jeff leave the same day on CA4126/CA709 to Seoul at 13:20.

items.title: Shanghai
items.detail: Four days. Lodging not booked. Sandra's blog has Shanghai posts from July 2017.

items.title: Shanghai to Atlanta
items.detail: DL 38 from Pudong 18:25, into LAX 15:24 the same day. Then DL 899 at 22:50.
